extracted text: The experimental materials were prepared with pure Al, pure Mg, pure Ag and Al–Cu, Al–Zr, Al–Mn master alloys by ingot metallurgy in a crucible furnace. These ingots with a size of 30 mm × 200 mm × 300 mm were homogenized at 500 °C for 24 h, hot rolled to 6 mm and then cold rolled to a 3 mm thin plate. All samples were solid solution treated at 515 °C for 1.5 h, subsequently water quenched and then immediately aged at 185 °C for different holding time. The aging time to reach the peak hardness was 8h for 0.4 wt% Mg alloy (143 HV), 4h for 0.8 wt% Mg alloy (157 HV), and 2h for 1.2 wt% Mg alloy (no significant increase from 0.8 wt% Mg alloy).
